title: Equifax was breached through a patched-elsewhere framework
body: The 2017 Equifax breach exposed data of about 147 million people via an Apache Struts vulnerability announced, with a patch, two months earlier; one internet-facing system missed the update and scanning missed the system. Postmortems emphasise asset inventory failure more than the bug. You cannot patch what your inventory insists does not exist.
source_hint: US House Oversight report on Equifax (2018)
